fieldValues.title: P2 Facilitated Decisions
fieldValues.summary: A group works through a projected semantic Protocol, agrees wording live and ratifies a complete decision.
fieldValues.body:
## Track

P

## Actor

Group using the shared-screen facilitation mode of the SRS-web governance workspace

## Durable Artifact

Ratified decision produced by a resumable Protocol run and readable as a whole.

## Entry Criteria

- F1 is closed
- SRS-web can open and edit the governance container workspace

## Included Capabilities

- Work With Meaning
- Present Facets

## Exclusions

- AI-generated wording
- Transcript ingestion and TSS emission
- A separate facilitation-only semantic store

## Walkthrough

In the same SRS-web repository workspace, project a Protocol, guide the group through each stage, resume after interruption, review the assembled record, ratify it and later read it back.

## Compatibility Promise

The Protocol presents and guides canonical meaning; it does not own or alter it.

## Stable After

Shared-screen manual facilitation is a first-class SRS-web mode, not a separate editor.

## Gaps

- P2/P3 substrate split in existing story bodies: muDemocracy.org#141: Before P2 implementation, move TSS emission and transcript-linked provenance from the manual P2 contract into P3 while retaining Protocol-run attention state in P2.
